Liftoff from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station is scheduled for Tuesday, April 14, at 5:33 a.m. EDT (0933 UTC). The first-stage booster for this mission, B1080 launching for a 26th time, will land on SpaceX's drone ship 'Just Read the Instructions', stationed in the Atlantic Ocean, roughly 8.5 minutes after leaving the launch pad. The mission, designated Starlink 10-24, will take a north-easterly trajectory on departure from Florida's Space Coast. Our live coverage with commentary will start about one hour prior to launch.
